# Hand-checked scoring cases for check_placement, written from docs/RULES.md.
# Every expected score was worked out by hand first; the arithmetic is in the comment under it.
#
# Format (parsed by scrabble_reference::parse_cases):
#   case: <unique name>
#   words: <the entire lexicon for this case, space separated; the line may be repeated>
#   board:
#   <15 lines of 15 characters: '.' empty, A-Z a tile, a-z a blank standing for that letter>
#   place: <square>=<letter> ...     (lower-case letter = a blank played as that letter)
#   expect: <score> | illegal
# Lines starting with '#' are comments. A blank line ends a case.
#
# Premium squares (from the RULES.md diagram):
#   TW  A1 H1 O1 A8 O8 A15 H15 O15
#   DW  B2 N2 C3 M3 D4 L4 E5 K5 H8 E11 K11 D12 L12 C13 M13 B14 N14
#   TL  F2 J2 B6 F6 J6 N6 B10 F10 J10 N10 F14 J14
#   DL  D1 L1 G3 I3 A4 H4 O4 C7 G7 I7 M7 D8 L8 C9 G9 I9 M9 A12 H12 O12 G13 I13 D15 L15
# Tile values: A1 B3 C3 D2 E1 F4 G2 H4 I1 J8 K5 L1 M3 N1 O1 P3 Q10 R1 S1 T1 U1 V4 W4 X8 Y4 Z10, blank 0.
#
# Boards used more than once:
#   "board A"  CAT across H8-J8 (the opening)
#   "board F"  board A plus TAKE down J8-J11
#   "board K"  CATALOGS across H8-O8 plus SPARROW down O8-O14

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- openings

place: K2=P K3=L K4=A K5=N K6=E K7=T K8=S
expect: 74
# 7 tiles down K2-K8, S hooking CAT.
# PLANETS: P3 + L1 + A1 + N on K5 (DW) 1 + E1 + T1 + S1 = 9; x2 = 18.
# CATS (cross-word): 3+1+1+1 = 6 (K8 plain; the DW on K5 is not in this word).
# 18 + 6 + 50 = 74.

place: I9=X J9=I
expect: 35
# Old blank inside a cross-word (blank T on J8).
# XI I9-J9: X on I9 (DL) 16 + I1 = 17.
# AX I8-I9: A1 + X 16 = 17.
# TI J8-J9: t0 + I1 = 1.
# 17 + 17 + 1 = 35.

place: I9=X J9=I
expect: 36
# A new tile on a premium counts in its main word and its cross-word.
# XI I9-J9: X on I9 (DL) 16 + I1 = 17.  AX I8-I9: A1 + 16 = 17.  TI J8-J9: T1 + I1 = 2.
# 17 + 17 + 2 = 36.

place: G7=G H7=A I7=M J7=E
expect: 23
# Parallel play above TAN forming three cross-words.
# GAME G7-J7: G on G7 (DL) 4 + A1 + M on I7 (DL) 6 + E1 = 12.
# AT H7-H8: 1+1 = 2.   MA I7-I8: M (DL) 6 + A1 = 7.   EN J7-J8: 1+1 = 2.
# 12 + 2 + 7 + 2 = 23.

place: K11=N K12=A K13=P
expect: 14
# Board F. A new tile on a DW counts in both words.
# NAP K11-K13 down: N on K11 (DW) 1 + A1 + P3 = 5; x2 = 10.
# EN J11-K11 across: E1 + N1 = 2; x2 (K11 covered this turn) = 4.
# 10 + 4 = 14.

place: A8=P B8=R C8=O D8=P F8=R G8=T H8=Y
expect: 158
# Not reachable in a real game (tiles on the board, H8 empty), but legal by the letter of
# rule 5: the board is not empty, and D8/F8 touch the old E. Tests a DW and a TW in one word (x6).
# PROPERTY A8-H8: P3 + R1 + O1 + P on D8 (DL) 6 + E1 (old) + R1 + T1 + Y4 = 18;
# A8 (TW) x3, H8 (DW) x2: 18 x6 = 108; 7 tiles: +50 = 158.

expect: 8
# Same unreachable board as above. Rule 5 asks for H8 only when the board is empty; this board

# Diagonal to the T only: forms no word of two letters and touches no old tile.

place: I9=X J9=U
expect: illegal
# Main word XU and cross-word AX are in the lexicon; cross-word TU (J8-J9) is not.

place: E8=B F8=A G8=T
expect: illegal
# BAT as placed is a word, but the maximal run is BATCAT (E8-J8), which is not.

place: I9=N

# Board F. AN (I8-I9, down) is a word but NA (I9-J9, across) is not: every word formed must be valid.
